mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy stance remains accommodative.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 7.5% signals weak labor market conditions that depress corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS show positive growth, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing slowdown indicated by declining industrial production leads to reduced corporate output and negative S&P 500 returns during the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 95, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising quarterly GDP level signals expanding economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 shows positive growth, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation above 230 on the CPI index signals potential monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 230.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent improvement in employment growth and declining unemployment rates indicate a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive and UNRATE is below 7.5%, or the interaction term is not significant (p>0.05) in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-rate environment where the federal funds rate is below 0.5%, monetary policy remains accommodative, supporting equity valuations and yielding positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
